messages:
Maya: Quick idea 1: introduce a short 'pilot-onboard' lane for customer-driven model pins. Purpose: validate benchmarks + rollback runway without full catalog pin policy changes.
Liam: Good. Whats the default pin length? Customers usually ask for 30d.
Maya: Default 14d for pilot, with auto-extend gates. Short enough to reduce ops risk.
Jun: Bench plan: throughput (tokens/s p50/p95), p95 latency, small regression suite (500 queries), and embed recall. Propose thresholds: embed_recall >= 0.87, p95_latency <= 1.5x baseline.
Priya: Sales will push for longer pins. We can offer a 30d opt-in if they take migration credits + comms SLA.
Maya: Ops constraints: need isolated canary pool + audit logs + toggle. Devon (ops) to confirm.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pool creation requested (id: pilot-canary-02). ETA: 02:05 UTC.
Priya: Also add legal-friendly SOW line about 'pilot pin, auto-extension criteria, and migration credits' so enterprise buyers see the fallback path.
Jun: CI hooks: nightly bench run on canary, auto-block if regressions exceed threshold. Also a manual replay endpoint for the regression set.
Maya: Launch checklist: 1) 7-day green nightly bench, 2) rollback playbook tested, 3) SOW + legal ok, 4) 2 pilot customers onboarded.
Priya: I'll secure two pilot customers that need conservative migration. Will negotiate credits.
Maya: Actions: Maya write comms + SOW by Fri; Jun deliver bench harness + dataset by Wed; Liam add UI toggle + audit logs by Wed; Priya recruit customers by Tue. Meeting Thu 9:30 PT to sign-off.
Liam: I'll draft a small config example for ops UI.
Maya: Thanks all, dropping the draft into #product-docs when ready.
